title: A Reproducible Mathematical Construction of a 1 fs Period Offset from a 240.1 Hz Reference Frequency
description: Version 2.0.0 extends the original reproducible construction by explicitly propagating the high-precision residual. From 1/240.1 - 1/f = 10^-15 s, the candidate f = 240.100000000057648... has residual delta_f = 5.764801000001384...e-11 Hz. Under the dimensionless scale N = 2401, the same residual propagates to N*delta_f = 1.3841287201003323...e-7 and N*f = 576480.100000138412.... This is an algebraic bookkeeping result only; no physical identification with the Brout-Englert-Higgs boson or any new constant is claimed without an independent physical model and experiment.
